candidates.statement: Postgres connection pool exhaustion at the order service: save_order spans show pool size 5 with 0 idle connections and fail with DependencyUnavailable, causing order POST ReadTimeout and gateway checkout 502s.
candidates.uncertainty: No postgres-side pool metrics or saturation time series; pool size/idle values come only from span attributes.

report.explanation: Traces show repeated postgres.save_order failures with pool size 5 and idle 0, propagating to order ReadTimeout and gateway 502s on /v1/checkout. Logs and metrics corroborate 502s and ~2s durations. Bounded to db-pool-exhaustion; postgres-side saturation metrics still needed to fully confirm.
